description: I am hopeful that we will finally end the legislative session this week — the House needs to stop fighting and move important budgets through the body that they have been holding “hostage.” In the Senate: Transportation and Income Taxes. Still no bill on Property Tax Relief but we are still fighting hard to introduce. […]
